panels.BAILEY_CROSS: Cross-examination sequence initiated. Look at the timeline. If the official's field report contradicts the raw body-cam or dispatch logs, their credibility is shattered under 42 USC 1983.
panels.SCALIA_TEXT: Show me the explicit text. Where does the statute grant them the authority to execute this action without a prior warrant? If the text does not say it, it does not exist. Immunity denied.
panels.TEXAS_PROSECUTOR: This is a straight-line breach of duty. They had a clear, non-discretionary operational mandate, and they willfully bypassed it. Document the chain of custody and pin down the malfeasance layout immediately.

wizard.title: SUI JURIS PUBLIC ACCOUNTABILITY DISPATCH
wizard.description: This guide will help determine what CAN or CANNOT happen with your potential legal claim in plain English.

steps.STEP_1: Was the person acting in an official capacity (like a police officer, judge, or city official) while on duty or using their official authority?
steps.STEP_2: Did their action directly violate a specific constitutional right (like your 4th Amendment protection against illegal search, or 1st Amendment free speech)?
steps.STEP_3: Does this official hold a formal, sworn oath of office to protect the public or execute specific statutory duties?
steps.STEP_4: Did they intentionally neglect their mandatory duty, or commit a clear act of wrongdoing/malfeasance?

results.TITLE: EVALUATION RESULTS
results.CAN_1983: You have the core elements for a Federal Civil Rights suit. Next Step: Look up standard Pro Se federal complaint templates for Section 1983.
results.CANNOT_1983: A federal civil rights claim is legally barred here. Why? Because standard law requires BOTH an official acting under power AND a direct constitutional violation. One or both of those elements is missing.
results.CLAIM_OATH: BREACH OF OATH / DERELICTION OF DUTY
results.CAN_OATH: There is a strong basis to pursue administrative or statutory liability. Next Step: Locate the official's public bond or file a formal administrative grievance.
results.CANNOT_OATH: A formal breach of duty claim is weak or barred. Why? To hold an official accountable for a breach of duty, the action must break a mandatory statutory rule, not just be unfair or aggressive behavior.
